description: This file defines a class 'EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator' that implements menu configuration logic for email subscription related functionality within the OrangeHRM admin module. It overrides screen settings to display the 'viewEmailNotification' screen.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for email subscription features; overrides specific screen views.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module and screen to 'viewEmailNotification' in the provided Screen object, then returns null.
